interview.name: Tess
interview.answer: The notes do not say when or where the repair drive is being held.

events.text: Tess: I heard the repair drive’s coming along nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all morning. Want me to keep an ear out for what they still need?
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Gus: That’d be great, Tess — thanks. If you hear they need hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords, let me know and I’ll round them up.
events.speaker: Gus

events.text: Tess: You bet — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords are still on the list.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Kira: You’re sure the repair drive is still happening, right?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on — I heard they’re setting everything up for this weekend.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Kira: Okay, good — can you confirm what time it starts?
events.speaker: Kira

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — we’re meeting by the community shed at 6. If you hear anything else, I’d appreciate it.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Tess: You got it — I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything new. Hope the shed setup goes smoothly!
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Uli: Thanks, Tess — that means a lot. I’ll see you by the shed at 6.
events.speaker: Uli

events.text: Cleo: I’m on it, Tess — I’ll check the supplies and let you know what’s still missing for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Tess: Perfect, Cleo — thanks! I’ll keep an ear out in case they still need hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Cleo: I’ll tally what we’ve got and send you the gaps as soon as I can.
events.speaker: Cleo

events.text: Tess: I’m keeping an ear out, Bo — last I heard folks were still dropping off tools, so I’ll let you know if hammers, screwdrivers, or extension cords are still needed.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Bo: Perfect — just keep me posted if anything big changes. I’m still focused on the broken fence panels and the leaky mailbox.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Tess: Will do, Bo — I’ll keep my ears open and let you know if the repair list changes, especially for those fence panels or the mailbox.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along any updates on what the repair drive still needs.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Pia: Thanks, Tess — that’d help. I’m still checking the supply list so we don’t end up with duplicates.
events.speaker: Pia

events.text: Tess: Of course — I’ll listen for any gaps and let you know if I hear they still need anything specific. Hopefully we can keep the duplicates down and fill in whatever’s missing.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Glad to hear it. Let’s keep it simple—check the supplies, then we can fill the gaps after lunch.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Sounds good — I’ll check what’s still missing and let you know after lunch. Hopefully it’s just a few tools left on the list.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Eli: Good plan. I’ll wait for your list after lunch, and we’ll take it from there.
events.speaker: Eli

events.text: Tess: Absolutely — I’ll keep my ears open and pass along whatever Rosa still needs for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Rosa: Thanks, Tess — if you hear of any urgent fixes, send them my way and I’ll keep the list organized for Sunday at the community center.
events.speaker: Rosa

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Tess: Will do, Rosa — I’ll keep an ear out for any urgent fixes and pass them along right away.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Thanks, Tess — I’m ready to help, so just point me to the first task for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Tess: Great — I’ll check what’s still needed and send you straight to the first open task.
events.speaker: Tess

events.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll be ready when you send it over, and I’ll jump on the first open task for the repair drive.
events.speaker: Mara
